remarks: Charming Wrightwood Cabin – Your Own Little Mountain Retreat!  This sweet little cabin in the heart of Wrightwood could be your perfect mountain getaway or cozy starter home! Featuring one bedroom plus a spacious loft that offers the flexibility to serve as a second bedroom, this charming home offers a downstairs bathroom, an open-concept kitchen and living area, updated kitchen and a beautiful rock wood-burning fireplace that adds the perfect touch of mountain charm. The cabin has been Fully Updated and features new insulated windows downstairs, creating a warm and inviting setting for relaxing and enjoying the mountain lifestyle.
